title: Nike Apocalypse
description: A surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a skeletal cowboy in a dripping hat holding a revolver and a glowing Nike sign, standing beside a giant iridescent beetle. A massive crowd gathers below under a fiery orange sky with a large dark planet, floating Nike logo, spaceships, and ruined structures.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic scene with a rotting skeletal cowboy wearing a dripping fedora, holding a revolver in one hand and a glowing neon Nike sign in the other. A massive iridescent green and black beetle stands in the foreground. Below them a huge crowd of tiny people gathers in an arena-like space. Background shows fiery orange sky, giant dark planet, floating Nike logo with sparkles, ruined buildings, and various flying ships. Dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed, surreal composition.
